data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. All other 24 fishers: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k of us choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250−8k. Next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%); all18 leaves50, then500 or100. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gains. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Fisher24/17/08/06: help recruit individual opt-ins.
